messages:
maria_sre: @here FYI: planned NAT-egress swap + targeted smoke test tomorrow 04/12 01:00-03:00 UTC. Well cut traffic to replacement NATs in us-east/us-west in a staged canary. Expect brief 5-20s spikes for a minority of flows.

sam_oncall: Which services are affected? Any customer opt-outs?

maria_sre: Affected: edge-gpu pools (pool-c, pool-d), control-plane artifact uploads. No customer opt-outs; well start at 5% traffic, ramp to 20% after 30m if metrics look good.

lee_net: Runbook posted: https://go/internal/runbooks/nat-egress-swap-19698. Key checks: KV cache hit ratio, artifact upload latency, and control-plane egress rate.

jamie_prod: Are we changing SLOs or status page? Need CS heads-up.

maria_sre: Temp SLO note: p99 gen latency bumped to 800ms for the window. Error SLO unchanged. slo-ops-bot will annotate. No public status update unless visible customer impact.

slo-ops-bot: (automated) SLO annotation created: nat-egress-swap-1969800000 window 1969800000-1969800120 temp p99=800ms.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: nat-egress/replacement-v2 -> canary @ 01:00 UTC, ramp plan: 5% -> 20% -> 100% if healthy. CI green.

maria_sre: Canary checklist snippet:
```
kubectl -n infra patch svc nat-egress --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/metadata/annotations/canary","value":"true"}]'
sleep 20
curl -s https://edge-health.internal/paths | jq .active_nat
```
Verify KV hit > 88% on canary nodes.

sam_oncall: Ill trigger a small synthetic at T+20m: 400 concurrent light gen reqs per region to exercise cold KV and routing. Will post progress here. Pager rule: page for >1.5% 5m error spike or sustained 5m p99 >950ms.

lee_net: Rollback command in runbook: `./rollback_nat.sh --run-id 19698`. Owners: lee_net + sam_oncall.

maria_sre: Final: 24h and 1h reminders will go out. DM me if you need a particular integration excluded (e.g., large bulk uploads).

sam_oncall: Will monitor dashboards and post a short summary after the window.

maria_sre: Thanks team. Will mark as internal maintenance unless customers see degradation. :thumbsup:
